scope: Classes, counts, codes and our code locations only. Database reads with default_transaction_read_only on; our scripts run on scratch copies; no code change.

items.subject: rasters against the batch area

area.madeFrom: 3D-models-gml-small-1 converted layer (frame from its first part)
area.extentUsed: drafted bounds of the one REVIEWED package (frameTx, SF1 D1)
area.analysisCrs: one EPSG code, differs from the source code
area.centreInSourceCrs: both coordinates of magnitude under 100: within about 100 m of the projected CRS's own origin
area.statedEnvelopeOfSmallModel: lower corner under 10 and upper corner under 10000 units, contains the area

mediumModel.source: stated gml Envelope in the original (the records hold none)

why: Far away, not beside and not spanning. The small model writes local coordinates near 0 under a projected
EPSG code, so the area sits at that projection's origin. The medium model with the same code lies 50 to
500 km from it; all three rasters lie over 500 km from both. Every corner transforms finitely, so the
refusal is the extent test in localPartsTx, not a transform fault. Widening the area would not place them.

export.flags: exactly as exportSheetCsv (headerless, columns, rows, record, member, ratio, bytes)

keepSheetError.method: Reproduced: the exact receipt keepSheet sends, parsed by LargeUploadCreateSchema; the same receipt with application/octet-stream passes. The catch neither logs nor stores the error, so no log holds it; native logs were not opened (runtime data folder).
keepSheetError.cause: receiveSheetDerivative sets mediaType text/csv; the contract allows only application/zip and application/octet-stream
keepSheetError.reach: Every sheet CSV, headed or headerless, takes this receipt, so any sheet that reaches it fails the same way.

askingSheets.failedCondition: regular (marked body cells: formula, error or no stored value)
passed: first text at most modal text

items.subject: the one 404 console error
items.routeTemplate: /:value (one root segment that is no route word)
items.status: null (no page response event); no request failure recorded
items.studioDoing: first load of the batch page, before files were added
items.likelyRequest: the browser's automatic root icon request: apps/studio/index.html names no icon and public/ holds none (inferred)
items.act1: the same single entry at act 1's first batch page load
